description: This file defines the SavingsTransactionDTO class, a data transfer object for representing savings transactions within the Fineract accounting module. It contains fields such as office ID, payment type ID, transaction date, transaction type, amount, fee and penalty payments, overdraft amount, transfer status, and associated tax payments, along with a method to determine if the transaction involves overdraft.

classes.name: SavingsTransactionDTO
classes.description: Data transfer object encapsulating details of a savings account transaction, including identifiers, date, transaction type, amount, fees, penalties, overdraft info, transfer status, and tax payments, with utility methods.

methods.name: isOverdraftTransaction
methods.description: Determines if the transaction involves an overdraft by checking if 'overdraftAmount' is greater than zero.
